marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to east 15 Wednesday
afternoon then backing to north 15 Wednesday evening. Scattered flurries changing to snow overnight then to
scattered flurries Wednesday evening. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.text:
Seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 late Wednesday
afternoon.<br/>
